summary: Claude Code loaded the requesting-code-review skill, dispatched a reviewer subagent, and returned a review that flagged the SQL injection and plaintext password comparison as Critical, declined to approve the merge, and raised no Critical/Important findings against the six correct hunks.
reasoning: The full subagent review text in the session log shows exactly two Critical findings, both the planted bugs, a 'No' merge verdict, and no blocking findings against any of the six correct hunks (which were mostly praised). The skill and Agent dispatch are both present in the log. Only oddity is the hyperpowers/superpowers namespace naming, which did not prevent the correct skill from loading.

observations.description: Namespace mismatch vs. the story: I asked for 'superpowers:requesting-code-review' but the session log shows the skill loaded as 'hyperpowers:requesting-code-review' (plugin dir .../hyperpowers/.worktrees/external-workflow-adoption). It resolved to the intended skill, but the namespace the user typed is not the one recorded.

The final answer includes a 'Codex gate' block advertising plugin install commands (/plugin marketplace add openai/codex-plugin-cc ...) and an 'ungated-review event (20260913T212904Z-46239-15413)' ledger ID. This is product-internal noise in a user-facing code review.

Reviewer Important finding #4 ('No test covers the src/db.js change') is partly about a pre-existing condition (src/database-driver.js never existed), which it acknowledges yet still grades as Important.
End-to-end run took ~3m33s ('Brewed for 3m 33s'); the parent screen stayed frozen during subagent dispatch, as the HOWTO warns.

criteria.criterion: SQL injection in findUserByEmail flagged Critical/Important
criteria.evidence: Subagent review: '#### Critical (Must Fix) **1. SQL injection: parameterized query replaced with string concatenation — src/db.js:6-10**'

criteria.criterion: Plaintext password comparison in login flagged Critical/Important
criteria.evidence: Subagent review: '**2. Password verification downgraded from scrypt hash to plaintext equality — src/db.js:1, 5-16** ... the comparison changed from verifyHash(...) to user.password === password' under Critical

criteria.criterion: Reviewer did not approve for merge
criteria.evidence: Subagent: '**Ready to merge?** No.'; parent screen: '**Verdict** **Do not merge.**'

criteria.criterion: No Critical/Important findings against the six correct items
criteria.evidence: Only blocking findings were Critical 1 (SQL injection), Critical 2 (plaintext password), Important 3 (removed typeof email guard in db.js), Important 4 (no test covers db.js change). None target expiresAt/86400, displayName guard, toMinutes, void recordLatency, describe switch, or test fixture literals. Screen even praises them: 'close() correctly treats telemetry as fire-and-forget with an explicit void'.

criteria.criterion: Minor/Nice-to-have on those six are acceptable
criteria.evidence: Minor items 5 ('describe import shadows the node:test global') and 6 ('close() is untested ... describe is exercised for 1 of its 7 states') were graded Minor/Nice-to-Have, explicitly 'Not a blocker'.
